name: New India
kurzbeschreibung: **Discover New India in Innsbruck** Experience the vibrant flavors and rich traditions of **India** right in the heart of the **Alps**! At **New India in Innsbruck**, we bring you an unforgettable culinary journey with authentic dishes, warm hospitality, and a touch of exotic charm. ### **A Taste of India** Indulge in our carefully crafted menu featuring classic Indian specialties: - **Butter Chicken** – Tender, spiced chicken in a creamy tomato gravy - **Biryani** – Fragrant basmati rice with succulent meat or vegetables - **Naan & Roti** – Freshly baked flatbreads, perfect for dipping - **Masala Dosa** – Crispy rice crepes stuffed with spiced potatoes - **Mango Lassi** – A refreshing yogurt drink with ripe mangoes And don’t miss our **Kaiserschmarrn** for dessert—a sweet, fluffy Austrian classic with a hint of Indian spices! ### **Why Visit Us?** ✔ **Authentic Flavors** – Made with love and traditional recipes ✔ **Cozy Atmosphere** – Warm lighting and comfortable seating ✔ **Vegetarian & Vegan Options** – Something for everyone ✔ **Takeaway & Catering** – Bring the taste of India home ### **Location & Opening Hours** 📍 **Innsbruck**, near the **Herz-Jesu-Kirche** 🕒 **Monday–Friday:** 11:30 AM – 10:00 PM 🕒 **Saturday–Sunday:** 12:00 PM – 11:00 PM **Come and explore the magic of India in the heart of Tirol!** 🌶️✨ --- **Visit our website** **📞 +43 512 123456** | **📧 info@new-india-innsbruck.at**
